name: Perinatal Lethal Hypophosphatasia

criteria.description: Markedly decreased serum alkaline phosphatase activity
Severe hypomineralization and defective ossification on skeletal radiographs
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the ALPL gene
Elevated plasma levels of pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP) and phosphoethanolamine (PEA)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of low serum alkaline phosphatase, characteristic radiologic findings, and biallelic pathogenic ALPL mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is confirmed by genetic testing; biochemical markers support clinical suspicion.

pathognomonic.notes: Radiographically evident bone hypomineralization is hallmark

pathognomonic.symptomName: Respiratory insufficiency due to chest deformity
pathognomonic.notes: Pulmonary hypoplasia secondary to thoracic cage abnormalities
searchTerms: difficulty breathing due to chest deformity
respiratory failure from chest wall abnormality

pathognomonic.symptomName: Markedly decreased serum alkaline phosphatase activity
searchTerms: very low alkaline phosphatase in blood

common.symptomName: Fractures and bone deformities at birth
common.notes: Multiple fractures due to defective bone mineralization
searchTerms: bone fractures and deformities in newborn

common.notes: Elevated serum calcium levels due to impaired bone uptake
Reduced muscle tone contributing to respiratory failure

occasional.symptomName: Seizures due to pyridoxine (vitamin B6) deficiency
occasional.notes: Secondary to impaired vitamin B6 metabolism
searchTerms: fits caused by lack of pyridoxine
epileptic seizures due to low vitamin B6

occasional.symptomName: Poor feeding and failure to thrive
occasional.notes: Due to systemic illness and respiratory compromise
searchTerms: difficulty feeding and not gaining weight
failure to thrive with feeding problems

occasional.notes: Secondary to hypercalcemia-induced nephrogenic diabetes insipidus

searchTerms: high vitamin B6 active form in blood
increased active vitamin B6 in plasma

rare.notes: Severe fetal edema in rare cases

laboratory: Markedly decreased serum alkaline phosphatase activity
imaging: Severe hypomineralization and defective ossification on skeletal X-rays
other: Low alkaline phosphatase activity in fibroblasts or leukocytes

distinguishingFeatures: Normal or elevated alkaline phosphatase activity
Absent or severely reduced ossification without biochemical abnormalities

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress due to chest deformity at birth
Markedly low serum alkaline phosphatase in a neonate with skeletal abnormalities
